list: The official 55-trophy PlayStation 5 list: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PSN until earned. Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them; Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55.
method: CONFIRMED means the requirement is stated in the official trophy description itself. EXPECTED means the method is worked out from the official description plus GTA V / GTA Online series patterns and what Rockstar showed in the GTA VI trailers; it has not been checked in the game yet, because the list was published before launch. Every guide names its sources beside it, and every count (42 range challenges, 14 drone locations, 18 meditation spots, 52 areas, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK locations, 250 stunts, 500 choices) is the number PSN itself tracks, as PSNProfiles lists it.

sources.exophase: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/
sources.psnprofiles: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (grades and PSN progress targets): https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi
sources.official: Rockstar Games — GTA VI official site: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI
sources.trailer1: Rockstar Games — GTA VI Trailer 1 (Dec 2023): first look at Vice City and Leonida
sources.trailer2: Rockstar Games — GTA VI Trailer 2 (May 2025): Lucia and Jason, Leonida locations, activities shown on screen
sources.series: GTA V / GTA Online — series patterns (mission replay, wanted levels, properties, collectibles) used to work out methods

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself the instant the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no separate task for it, and the official description says only that you are a Leonida Legend. The sensible order is the roadmap in this guide: story first (it unlocks the map, the contacts and the activities), then the stranger strands, then the activities and collectibles, and the long counts last, because the 250 stunts, 100 vehicles and 100 WAiNK locations all tick over while you do everything else. The last two trophies for most players will be the 100% gold and this one, in that order.
steps: Play the story through Chapters 1–4 and the final mission, doing the two partner trophies before the finale.
Finish all eight stranger strands, the activity trophies and the collectible sets.
Let the long counts (250 stunts, 100 vehicles, 100 WAiNK locations, 500 choices) finish in free roam.
Check the tracker: the platinum unlocks as soon as the counter reads 54 of 54.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy, and the first one most players earn: it is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in which Lucia and Jason take their first job together after her return to Vice City, as Trailer 2 shows. There is nothing to prepare and no way to fail permanently — follow the mission markers, complete each objective the game gives you, and the trophy pops at the mission-pass screen. If you fail a section, the game restarts you at the last checkpoint, exactly as GTA V did.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission markers and complete each objective in order.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-pass screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable: play every Chapter 1 mission in story order and finish the chapter finale, and this pops at the chapter-complete screen. Chapter 1 is the game's opening stretch — Lucia settling back into Vice City, the first jobs with Jason, and the contacts who hand out the rest of the story. Nothing in a chapter can be skipped or locked out: if a mission beats you, retry from the checkpoint, and after repeated failures GTA games offer to skip the failed section, so the chapter itself is never at risk.
steps: Play every Chapter 1 mission in story order.
Finish the chapter finale mission.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter-complete screen appears.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable chapter trophy: clear Chapter 2's missions in order and finish its finale. The chapter's name is a nod to the drug-money jobs that drive this stretch of the plot, and by its end you should have met the contacts behind several side strands — check the map for new stranger markers after the chapter closes, because new ones appear as the story advances. As with every chapter, mission replay (the series standard since GTA V) means a failed mission never locks you out.
steps: Play every Chapter 2 mission in story order.
Finish the chapter finale mission.
After the chapter closes, sweep the map for new stranger markers.
The trophy unlocks at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable chapter trophy: work through Chapter 3's missions in order and finish the finale. This is the stretch where the story moves into the heart of Vice City itself — Trailer 2 shows the city, its beaches and its nightlife heavily — and it is the point where the bigger heist setups begin, the ones the later chapters pay off. Keep an eye out for new activity venues and stranger markers opening up as the chapter progresses; they feed the activities and strands phases of the roadmap.
steps: Play every Chapter 3 mission in story order.
Note the new contacts, venues and stranger markers the chapter opens.
Finish the chapter finale mission — the trophy unlocks at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable chapter trophy and the last one before the finale: clear Chapter 4's missions in order and finish its finale. These are the highest-stakes jobs of the game, with the biggest payouts and the hardest fights, and they set up the final mission directly. Before you start the finale itself, stop and work through the Before the Finale checklist in this guide — the two partner trophies and the other moment-sensitive ones all need doing while your partner is still freely available in free roam.
steps: Play every Chapter 4 mission in story order.
Finish the chapter finale mission — the trophy unlocks at the chapter-complete screen.
Before starting the final mission, clear the Before the Finale checklist.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy, unmissable — but the timing matters for other trophies. Finish the final mission and this gold pops at the mission-pass screen. The warning is about what comes after: the two partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) need your partner beside you in free roam, and which characters are available after the ending is not confirmed by any official source yet, so the safe play is to earn both before you start the finale. Do the Before the Finale checklist, save, then enjoy the ending.
steps: Before the finale: earn Hot Together and Retail Therapy while your partner is freely available.
Also clear Cal's fishing challenge and Bret's hunt if they are open.
Play the final mission to its end — the gold pops at the mission-pass screen.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable named-mission trophy: play Breakfast Run when it appears in the story flow and finish it. The mission's name and the trophy's — Trust — point to an early job that sets up the working trust between Lucia and Jason, the partnership Trailer 2 puts at the centre of the game. There is no special requirement beyond completing the mission: follow the markers, finish the objectives, and the trophy pops at the mission-pass screen. A failed attempt restarts at the checkpoint.
steps: Play the story until the Breakfast Run mission unlocks.
Complete its objectives and reach the mission-pass screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable named-mission trophy for one of the game's big set-piece heists. The Cartel Heist follows the heist structure GTA V established: expect a planning stage and setup missions first, then the heist itself with a crew and a loud getaway. Do the setups when they appear — they are part of the mission chain, not optional — then complete the heist and the trophy pops at the pass screen. Stock up on armour and ammo before the finale run, and keep a fast car in mind for the getaway.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist unlocks; finish its setup missions first.
Stock up on armour and ammo before the heist itself.
Complete the heist — the trophy unlocks at the mission-pass screen.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable named-mission trophy: complete Child's Play when it appears in the story flow. The trophy name (Family Matters) and the mission name both point to a job tangled up with family — one of the pair's relatives, or a contact's kid — in the GTA tradition of missions that mix crime with domestic chaos. No special requirement beyond finishing the mission: follow the markers, complete the objectives, and it pops at the pass screen. If a section beats you, the checkpoint retry brings you straight back.
steps: Play the story until the Child's Play mission unlocks.
Complete its objectives and reach the mission-pass screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable named-mission trophy: complete Headliners in the story flow. The stylised title suggests a music-scene job — possibly tied to one of the in-game artists Rockstar showed in the trailers, and to the club and DJ strand that Tyrone's missions also touch. Whatever the setting, the requirement is the same as every mission trophy: finish the mission and it pops at the pass screen. Play it when it appears; there is no way to miss a story mission.
steps: Play the story until the Headliners mission unlocks.
Complete its objectives and reach the mission-pass screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable named-mission trophy: complete VCIA Takedown in the story flow. VCIA is Vice City International Airport, and the pun in the trophy name gives away the theme — a hijacking, most likely a vehicle or aircraft theft set piece on the runways or in the cargo areas. Expect a driving section and a firefight; bring ammo and armour. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at the pass screen. The airport is also the setting for the Catch Me If You Can free-roam trophy, so learn the runway layout while you are here.
steps: Play the story until the VCIA Takedown mission unlocks.
Complete its objectives — expect driving and a firefight around the airport.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-pass screen.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable named-mission trophy: complete Operation Savage Glory in the story flow. The operation name sounds military, and the trophy name hints at product at its centre — most likely one of the bigger late-game missions, with a planned assault and a heavy getaway. Treat it like a heist: full armour, a good rifle, and a fast car for the exit. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at the pass screen; a failed attempt restarts at the checkpoint.
steps: Play the story until the Operation Savage Glory mission unlocks.
Go in stocked: armour, rifle ammo, a getaway car in mind.
Complete its objectives and reach the mission-pass screen.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy and the real endgame: 100% completion. In GTA V that meant story missions, stranger missions, hobbies, collectibles and stunts, and the same shape applies here — the checklist is built from the trophy list itself, every activity, collectible set and count the other trophies name. The practical way to chase it is the in-game stats page, which lists what is still missing, plus this guide's roadmap: finish the story, then the strands, then the collectibles, then the long counts. It is the last gold most players earn, popping just before the platinum.
steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand.
Complete all collectible sets and activity counts the other trophies list.
Open the in-game 100% checklist (stats menu) and clear the remaining items one by one.
The gold pops when the checklist reads 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver grind: 250 stunts, counted by PSN. A stunt in GTA means a jump, a near-miss, long airtime or a drift, and the game counts them as you play — so do not grind this separately at first. Drive fast, take the ramps and stunt jumps scattered around Leonida, and let the count build through the story and the map sweep. Once the story is done, check the PSN progress counter for the remainder, then farm it by repeating a short jump loop in a fast car: the same ramp, the same landing, over and over. It is a patience trophy, not a skill one.
steps: Play normally — jumps, near-misses and drifts all count toward the total.
Take the stunt jumps you pass during the story and the map sweep.
Check the PSN progress counter for the remainder after the story.
Farm the rest by repeating one reliable jump loop in a fast car.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: A sampler trophy: try all 9 activity types once. The trailers show fishing, golf, bowling, drone racing, shooting ranges, arcade games, meditation spots and hunting — the 9 counted types are the game's side activities, and PSN tracks the set. Open the activities menu (or visit each venue) and do one of each; the trophy pops when the ninth type registers. Do this early in free roam: it also opens the starting points for several other trophies, including the fishing challenge, the shooting range and the drone races.
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Do one of each — fishing, a race, the range, an arcade game, bowling, a drone race, meditation, hunting and golf (or the game's equivalents).
The trophy pops when the ninth type registers.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver skill trophy and the hardest pure-skill check on the list: gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — 42 is the count PSN tracks. The range is a returning GTA activity: timed target courses with pistols, rifles and more, and gold means beating the top time or score on every course. Work through the weapon classes one at a time, easiest first; run each course once to learn its target layout before going for gold, and use a controller for fine aim. Expect a focused session or two, and take breaks — tired aim fails gold runs.
steps: Find a Shooting Range (Ammu-Nation in the series) and open its challenge list.
Run each of the 42 challenges once to learn the target layout.
Go for gold class by class, easiest weapons first.
The trophy pops on the last gold medal.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at all 14 locations — 14 is the count PSN tracks. Top Fun is the RC and drone brand from GTA V's races, and Trailer 2 shows drone racing over Leonida, so expect gate courses over beaches, rooftops and wetlands. Each location hosts its own race and needs one win; learn each track's gates and shortcuts on a practice run, keep the drone low through the gates, and do the shorter tracks first. Check the race menu after each win to see which locations are still missing.
steps: Open the Top Fun drone race menu and list the 14 locations.
Practice a track once to learn its gates, then race to win it.
Win each location once, shortest tracks first.
The trophy pops when the 14th location is won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — land, sea or air, across Leonida. The count is of distinct races, not total wins, so variety matters: winning the same street circuit five times counts once. Races unlock as you meet contacts and visit race start points, so sweep the race menu after each story chapter. The easiest path is the short street races first, then off-road, then boat and air races; a tuned car from the story's later chapters makes the street set much easier.
steps: Open the race menu and note the un-won races.
Win the short street circuits first, then off-road, boat and air races.
Check the menu between races — new events unlock as the story advances.
The trophy pops on the 20th distinct race win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — take this the moment Cal offers it. Cal is a fishing contact, met through the fishing activity, who challenges you to a contest: catch more, or bigger, fish than him inside the time limit. Fishing was shown in Trailer 2, with rods, boats and tackle, and the challenge is a named NPC event — if you refuse it or walk away, it may not be offered again, so do not put it off. Before you accept, buy the best rod and bait you can afford, then fish the spots the game marks and keep your line in the water the whole challenge.
steps: Unlock fishing and meet Cal through the activity.
Buy the best rod and bait available before the challenge.
Accept his fishing challenge as soon as it is offered — do not put it off.
Out-fish him inside the time limit to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play one arcade game to completion — finishing a full game, not just starting one. Arcades are a GTA staple, and Trailer 2 shows neon arcade cabinets around Vice City. Pick the shortest cabinet you find, learn its rules in one practice run, then play it through to the end screen. Any arcade game counts, and it also ticks one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so do it while you are sampling activities.
steps: Find an arcade (look for the neon cabinets in Vice City).
Pick the shortest game and learn its rules in one practice run.
Play it through to its end screen — the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: finish Andy's mission chain. Andy is one of the stranger contacts whose missions unlock across the map — play each of his jobs in order until the final one. Stranger strands in GTA usually unlock by visiting a map marker or answering a call, so check the map for Andy's icon after each story chapter; new markers appear as the story advances. His final mission pops the trophy at its pass screen, and the strand counts as one of the eight for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Andy's first mission marker on the map and play it.
Return for each follow-up mission as the strand unlocks.
Complete his final mission — the trophy pops at the pass screen.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: finish Kenton's mission chain. The name hints his strand involves boats or a marina, so expect water work — keep a boat handy and be ready for chases across the bay. Play his jobs in order from his map marker, checking for new markers after each story chapter, and finish his final mission for the trophy. The strand counts as one of the eight for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Kenton's first mission marker and play it.
Work through his strand mission by mission — expect boat work.
Complete his final mission — the trophy pops at the pass screen.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: finish Billy's mission chain. The Lone Rider points to a biker — Billy is likely tied to Leonida's biker gangs, so expect motorcycle missions and gang runs through the backroads. Keep a fast bike in a garage for his jobs. Play his strand in order from his map marker, checking for new markers between story chapters, and finish his final mission for the trophy. It counts as one of the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Billy's first mission marker and play it.
Work through his strand mission by mission, on a bike where it fits.
Complete his final mission — the trophy pops at the pass screen.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver strand trophy: finish 8 stranger mission strands in full. Strangers are the question-mark contacts scattered across Leonida, each strand a chain of two to five missions. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own trophy, and those five count toward the eight — so you need three more strands beyond them. Check the map after every story chapter, since new markers appear as the story advances, and finish each strand's final mission to count it. Track your total in the in-game stats.
steps: Play the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (5 of 8).
Find three more stranger strands from map markers after each chapter.
Complete each strand's final mission — the trophy pops on the 8th.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: finish Randy's mission chain. Supply & Demand suggests a smuggling or supply-running strand — expect fetch-and-deliver jobs across Leonida, moving goods between towns while the heat is on. A fast car with good handling helps more than firepower here. Play his missions in order from his map marker, and finish his final mission for the trophy. It counts as one of the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Randy's first mission marker and play it.
Work through his strand mission by mission — keep a fast car ready.
Complete his final mission — the trophy pops at the pass screen.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-strand trophy: finish Tyrone's mission chain. Spin On This! hints at a DJ or music-scene strand — Tyrone is likely tied to Leonida's club scene, which Trailer 1 shows heavily, so expect nightclub jobs and music-world errands. Play his missions in order from his map marker, checking for new markers between story chapters, and finish his final mission for the trophy. It counts as one of the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Find Tyrone's first mission marker and play it.
Work through his strand mission by mission.
Complete his final mission — the trophy pops at the pass screen.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots — 18 is the count PSN tracks. Meditation is a new Leonida activity: quiet scenic spots — beaches, hilltops, the Everglades-style wetlands — where you sit and breathe through a short scene. The spots are marked once discovered, so the practical method is to fold them into the map sweep for the exploration trophy: drive to each grey area, meditate at any spot you find there, and WAiNK the location at the same time. Check the PSN progress counter to see how many are left.
steps: Find meditation spots — map markers and scenic viewpoints.
Meditate at each one until the scene completes.
Fold the far-flung spots into the exploration map sweep.
The trophy pops at the 18th spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — one hunt, one animal, and only inside Bret's strand. Bret is a hunting contact who asks you to take down a unique animal, a named one-of-a-kind beast — the series has done this before with rare animals. The trap is shooting it early: the trophy is for hunting it for Bret, so a kill outside his mission may not count, and a unique animal may not respawn. Meet Bret, start his strand, and wait for the hunt itself. When it starts, track the animal, use a scoped rifle, and take a clean shot.
steps: Meet Bret and start his hunting strand.
Wait for the unique-animal hunt — do not kill the animal outside the mission.
Track it, use a scoped rifle, and take it down cleanly inside the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver collectible trophy: complete 3 card sets. Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, on benches, in interiors — and each set is a group of cards on one theme, a character, a car, a location. Pick up cards as you explore rather than hunting them alone; the collection menu shows which sets are close to complete, so focus the sets with the fewest cards left. Three finished sets pop the trophy — you do not need every card in the game. Cards are not missable: they stay in the world after the story.
steps: Pick up collectible cards while exploring — check interiors and landmarks.
Open the collection menu and find the sets nearest completion.
Finish any 3 sets — the trophy pops on the third.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver grind: use the WAiNK app — Leonida's in-game photo and social app, shown in Trailer 2 — at 100 distinct locations. WAiNK It means opening the app at a spot and sharing a photo or check-in, and the game counts distinct locations, so repeating the same beach does nothing. The only sane method is to fold it into everything else: WAiNK at every landmark, beach, town and viewpoint you pass during the story, the map sweep and the meditation run. 100 is a lot — never make a trip for WAiNK alone until the end, when the counter tells you how many are left.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at a location and post or check in.
Repeat at new locations while exploring — the game counts distinct spots only.
Fold it into the map sweep and the meditation run.
The trophy pops at the 100th location.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's checklist goals — stunt jumps, race wins, collectibles, combat feats — and they stack up naturally as you chase the other trophies, so do not grind this one directly. Open the challenges menu to see which are close, then clear the easy ones: short races, simple stunts, a few collectibles. By the time you are halfway through the other counts, this milestone trophy will be near done on its own.
steps: Open the challenges menu and note the nearly-done ones.
Clear easy challenges (races, stunts, collectibles) first.
Let the rest come from the other trophies' counts.
The trophy pops on the 50th completed challenge.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do this while your partner is available in free roam, before the finale. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level — rob a store, shoot up a street, steal a cop car, enough heat that the game shows four stars — then lose it: break line of sight, hide in alleys or off-road, and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner is the whole point — the game checks that both of you escape together, so do not ditch them mid-chase. A quiet stretch of countryside makes the hiding part much easier.
steps: Bring your partner along in free roam (before the final mission).
Build a 4-star wanted level together.
Drive somewhere quiet, break line of sight and hide until the stars clear — both of you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do this while your partner is available in free roam, before the finale. With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row without letting your wanted level drop between them: walk in, aim at the clerk, grab the cash, leave, and drive straight to the next shop while the stars stay up. Plan a route of three close shops in advance — a strip mall or a high street with three stores on one road — keep a fast car outside each one, and do not stop for anything else. If the stars clear, the chain resets and you start over.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three close shops in advance.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level up.
Drive straight to shops two and three and rob them too — the trophy pops on the third.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles — the game counts a vehicle as discovered when you first enter or drive it, and PSN tracks the total. Leonida's traffic is varied: cars, bikes, boats, planes, trucks and more. Variety is the trick: steal a different car on every street, try boats at the marina, grab a plane at the airport, and hop on every bike you pass. Register the rare ones with the Scooter Bros app too — that also feeds the On the Spot trophy. The counter is in the stats menu.
steps: Drive a different vehicle at every chance — variety counts, not repeats.
Try boats, planes and bikes as well as cars.
Register rare finds in the Scooter Bros app for a second trophy.
The trophy pops on the 100th distinct vehicle.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is GTA VI's slow-motion aiming mode, shown in Trailer 2 — the series' focus mechanic, close to Dead Eye in style. To take down 5 enemies in one use, find a fight where enemies cluster: a gang shootout or a wanted-level firefight with at least five hostiles in view. Trigger Combat Focus and land killing shots on five of them before the meter runs out — use a high-damage weapon, aim for headshots, and start with the nearest targets. If the meter empties at four, just retry: it is a skill check, not a one-shot chance.
steps: Find a firefight with at least 5 clustered enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before the meter empties.
If the meter runs out first, retry — the attempt costs nothing.
The trophy pops on the fifth takedown in that single use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: An airport stunt: leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — steal a plane or helicopter and take off without following the rules. The simplest read of the description is to enter VCIA, grab an aircraft from the runway or the hangars, and fly out. Expect police attention the moment you cross the fence, so be quick: sprint to a plane, take off and climb. The trophy pops once you are airborne and clear of the airport airspace. You will already know the runway layout from the VCIA Takedown mission.
steps: Enter VCIA and reach the runways or hangars.
Steal a plane or helicopter.
Take off and leave the airport airspace — the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is GTA's tank, and this trophy is about getting into one — and surviving the heat it brings. In the series, tanks appear at the military base or during high wanted levels, and the same two routes should work here: reach a 5-star wanted level and wait for the military response, or find the base and steal a Rhino from inside. Once you are in the tank and the game registers the moment, the trophy pops. Expect a lot of attention — tanks draw the army — so drive it somewhere open and enjoy the chaos.
steps: Reach a 5-star wanted level or enter the military base to find a Rhino tank.
Get inside the Rhino.
The trophy pops once you are driving it under fire.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the moment — a clean stealth job, and the attempt itself is the risk. Pick a jewelry store, case it first, and rob it without any alarm or detection: go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, that attempt fails — but the store can be retried later, so it is not a one-chance trophy in the way the partner ones are. Plan the exit before you go in, keep a fast car parked close, and do not linger over the display cases.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet approach and exit.
Rob it without being seen or triggering an alarm.
Leave clean — the trophy pops on a fully undetected robbery.
If spotted, leave and retry the store later.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver heist trophy: rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the bigger robbery targets — expect alarms, timers and police chases. Each vault is a job in itself: get in, crack or blow the vault, grab the cash and escape the wanted level. Five successful escapes pop the trophy. Bring a fast getaway car, plan the route out before you go in, and do them one at a time between other work — the Marked Bills they pay also feed the laundering trophy, so every vault pulls double duty.
steps: Find a bank vault target and plan the getaway first.
Rob the vault and escape the wanted level.
Bank the Marked Bills — they feed the laundering trophy too.
Repeat for 5 vaults — the trophy pops on the fifth escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: A classic GTA job: rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol Leonida's roads — spot one, force it to stop by ramming it, blocking it or shooting the driver, crack the back open and grab the cash, then lose the wanted level. The name nods to GTA V's Blitz Play armored-truck heist, and the method is the same one that worked there. One successful robbery and escape pops the trophy; pick a quiet road so the getaway is easier.
steps: Find an armored truck on a quiet road and force it to stop.
Break into the back and take the cash.
Escape the wanted level — the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the whole map, with 52 the count PSN tracks. Leonida is the state around Vice City: the city itself, the beaches, the Everglades-style wetlands, small towns and farmland. The game counts an area as explored when you enter it. Drive everywhere: take the highways between towns, boat through the wetlands, fly over the far corners. The map screen shows which areas are still grey. This pairs with the WAiNK and meditation trophies — explore once, and collect everything on the way.
steps: Drive, boat and fly through every part of the map.
Watch the map screen — grey areas are unexplored.
WAiNK and meditate at each new spot as you pass it.
The trophy pops when all 52 areas are visited.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs — 9 is the count PSN tracks. Gangs run hidden operations around Leonida: drug labs, stash houses, smuggling depots. Robbing one means hitting the location and taking its goods. Nine gangs, nine hits. The map and street intel point to the operations; do them one gang at a time and keep count in the stats menu. Expect armed resistance at each one — go in with armour and a rifle, and have a getaway car ready.
steps: Locate an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang, taking its goods.
Keep count in the stats menu as you go.
The trophy pops when the 9th gang's operation is robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A pure vibe trophy: have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach — Vice City's famous beachfront, shown in Trailer 1 — find a beach bar or a spot with a view, and order a cocktail. The game checks the location and the drink: sit, sip, and the trophy pops. Do it any time; it is a nice break between missions, and it pairs with the beach stops on the exploration sweep.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Find a beach bar or viewpoint spot.
Order and enjoy a cocktail with the view — the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A reference to the classic GTA showroom smash: drive a car into — or out of — a vehicle showroom through the glass. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or drive one at the front window, and smash your way out through the glass. The game checks the destruction and the exit, so one good smash does it. Any showroom counts; the fastest is the one nearest a main road, so the getaway is easy. Expect a wanted level and a repair bill.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and get a car to its front glass.
Smash through the glass and out of the showroom.
The trophy pops on the smash exit.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. Bowling returns from GTA IV — roll a ball, knock down pins, and the follow-through is the animation after your throw. Find the Kolt & Associates alley (a law-firm front, in the GTA tradition of joke businesses), play a frame or a full game, and the trophy pops when the follow-through registers. It also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so fold it into the activity sampler.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling.
The trophy pops when the follow-through registers.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The vaguest trophy on the list — and this guide says so honestly. The description names only a partnership with mass appeal, and no official source pins the trigger down yet. The best reading is a shared public moment with your partner: in the trailers Lucia and Jason's partnership is the game's heart, and a WAiNK post, a stunt or a public moment done together is the most likely trigger. Play the story and the partner activities, try the public-facing activities with your partner beside you, and it should come from a shared moment rather than a grind. If it has not popped by the end of the story, revisit the partner activities in free roam.
steps: Play the story and partner activities together.
Try public moments with your partner — a WAiNK post, a stunt, a shared activity.
The trophy pops at that partnership beat; revisit partner activities in free roam if it has not by the finale.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PSN tracks a count to 500 for this one: make 500 choices. Choices here means the small decisions the game tracks — dialogue picks, activity choices, purchases, responses to strangers. It is a long cumulative counter that grows as you play everything else, so do not chase it directly: play the story, do the strands, try the activities, and it will climb. Check the PSN progress counter from time to time to see where you stand; if it is short at the end, the fastest top-up is working through shop purchases and dialogue-heavy stranger missions.
steps: Play the game broadly — story, strands, activities, shops.
Make dialogue and activity choices whenever offered.
Check the PSN progress counter as the run goes on.
The trophy pops at the 500th tracked choice.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail once, succeed the second time. This trophy is for retrying something after a failure — the natural reading is to fail a mission or activity, then pass it on the immediate retry. In GTA, failing a mission and retrying from the checkpoint is routine, so this will likely pop on its own during a hard mission. If it has not popped by the end of the story, pick a short mission, fail it once on purpose, and pass it on the retry — the trophy should follow the successful second attempt.
steps: Fail a mission or activity once.
Retry it immediately and pass it on the second attempt.
The trophy pops on the successful retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a random event. Leonida is full of odd encounters: the series has done UFOs, ghosts and stranger events since GTA V, and the trophy's description is the reaction the game wants. Keep your eyes open while exploring: unusual lights, odd NPCs, strange scenes in remote places. It cannot be forced, but exploring the whole map for the exploration trophy maximises your chances — the remote corners and the wetlands at night are the likeliest places. When something weird happens, the trophy pops.
steps: Explore remote and unusual parts of Leonida, including the wetlands at night.
Watch for strange events, lights or encounters.
The trophy pops when you witness one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by: hit someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a bat or a similar melee weapon from the car window, and knock them over. It is the silliest trophy on the list — one clean hit does it. Use a slow car on a quiet street so you can aim the swing, and expect a wanted level afterwards; lose the stars before moving on. The bowling pun in the name is a nod to the bowling trophy, not a requirement.
steps: Equip a melee weapon (a bat) and get in a car.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian on a quiet street and swing from the vehicle.
Knock them over — the trophy pops on the hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty cash from robberies and heists — you cannot spend them directly, so you wash them through contacts (fences, launderers) for clean money. Rob banks, vaults and trucks to build up Marked Bills, then find your laundering contacts and wash them; the counter is cumulative, so keep laundering as you earn. The five bank vaults alone pay a large share of the total, which is why the heist phase comes before the money phase in the roadmap.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists — the 5 bank vaults pay well.
Find a laundering contact and wash the bills.
Keep laundering as you earn — the counter is cumulative.
The trophy pops once $250,000 has been laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, food, weapons, cars, anything sold in Leonida's stores. The counter is cumulative across every shop type, so it grows naturally as you buy gear for the other trophies: ammo for the range, rods and bait for fishing, cars for the races. If it is short at the end, buy the most expensive ammo and car upgrades you can find — ammunition is the fastest way to burn cash. Check the stats menu for the running total.
steps: Buy gear, clothes, food and ammo as you play.
Check the stats menu for the cumulative spend.
Top up with expensive ammo or car upgrades to reach $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties — 8 is the count PSN tracks. Garages are the property purchases of GTA VI: safehouses with parking, in the series tradition. They appear on the in-game property map as you progress; each costs money, so save up — laundered cash from the Marked Bills helps. Buy all eight and the trophy pops. Garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles the Scooter Bros trophy needs, so buy them before you start registering cars.
steps: Save money (launder Marked Bills for clean cash).
Buy garage properties from the in-game property map.
Use the garages to store vehicles for the Scooter Bros trophy.
The trophy pops when all 8 are owned.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — Leonida's vehicle-delivery app, in the same family as the app-based services Trailer 2 shows all over the city. Open the app on the in-game phone, register a vehicle you own or drive (the app lets you add a car to its fleet), and repeat for 10 distinct vehicles. Use the cars in your garages — buying all 8 garages gives you plenty to register — and the counter is in the app itself.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Register a vehicle to the app.
Repeat for 10 distinct vehicles — the trophy pops on the tenth.
